title: Cheesy Chicken Broccoli Rice
seoTitle: Cheesy Chicken Broccoli Rice | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: One-pot cheddar chicken and rice for ten
subtitle: One-pot cheddar chicken and rice for ten
description: Chicken breast cubes cook with rice and broccoli in one pot, then finish with sharp cheddar until creamy and cohesive. Simple seasoning, big portions, minimal dishes.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.instruction: Season cubed chicken with salt, garlic powder, and onion powder. Sear in butter 4–5 minutes until lightly golden—not fully cooked through.

steps.title: Add rice and broth
steps.instruction: Stir in rice and onion, toast 1 minute, then pour in broth. Bring to boil, cover, reduce to low simmer.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.instruction: Cook covered 18 minutes without lifting lid until rice absorbs liquid and chicken reaches 165°F internal. Target oven/smoker temperature: 165°F.

steps.title: Steam the broccoli
steps.instruction: Nestle broccoli on top, cover, and cook 8 more minutes until broccoli tender and rice fluffy.

steps.title: Finish with cheese
steps.instruction: Remove from heat, stir in cheddar and remaining butter until melted and creamy. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

proTips: Rotisserie chicken shredded in at the end skips the sear step on busy nights.
A teaspoon of mustard powder in the cheese adds depth without tasting like mustard.
Hot sauce on the table beats cooking spice into the whole pot.
tonightSpread: One-pot scoops with dinner rolls and simple mixed greens.
Extra shredded cheese at the line for crew who want it cheesier.
leftovers: Reheat with splash of broth in a covered pan on low.
Press cold leftovers into patties and pan-fry for crispy rice cakes.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Every hall has a version of this dish because it works. One pot, familiar flavors, and even rookies can follow the steps without burning the house down.
mealPrepNotes: Cut chicken uniform so it cooks with the rice. Add broccoli in the last 8 minutes so it stays green. Stir cheese off heat for smoothest melt.
